timeline.summary: UFLEX successfully commissioned its recycling unit of PET bottles and mixed plastics at Noida with a capacity of 39,600 MTA.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,055.92 Cr (+6.3% YoY), net profit ₹196.03 Cr (+16.3% YoY).
UFlex reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,056 Cr and net profit of ₹196 Cr, reflecting strong volume growth and margin expansion.
UFlex reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,097 Cr (+5.7% YoY) and normalized EBITDA of ₹611 Cr (+27% YoY).
UFLEX Limited’s earnings conference call recording (June 1, 2026, 4:00 PM IST) uploaded by **Ritesh Chaudhry**, Sr. Vice President - Secretarial & Compliance, on company website.
UFlex hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on June 1, 2026, highlighting strong volume recovery and margin expansion.
2026-10-20: CRISIL reaffirmed UFLEX's AA-/Negative (long-term) and A1+ (short-term) ratings on ₹4,600 Cr bank facilities
Special Resolution to borrow up to Rs 5000.00 Crore approved by members on 31 October 2026.
